name: Bad Craftwars
desc:
Welcome to Bad Craftwars, where players must mine ores, craft weapons, and battle their way through a variety of biomes and bosses to progress. 

With a vast array of weapons, players can experiment with different play styles and create the perfect arsenal to suit their needs. Players can continually improve their weapons to take on tougher enemies and bosses. 

Are you ready to craft your way to victory and become the ultimate warrior in the Bad Craftwars universe?
